evals.prompt: Run /setup-rblf-skills to configure this repository. It has a docker-compose.yml with api (Bun + NestJS + Prisma) and web (Next.js + Apollo GraphQL codegen) services, an origin/develop branch alongside origin/main, and an existing AGENTS.md file.
evals.expected_output: Explores the repo, detects Docker Compose + full-stack API/Web + Prisma + GraphQL codegen signals, and lazily loads ONLY stack-docker-fullstack.md (not the Python or Node-only adapters). Presents a 4-section configuration proposal with recommended defaults: Section A (two-branch main + develop workflow), Section B (5-stage atomic commit pipeline with Dockerized gates), Section C (Dockerized verification gates, verify-smoke.mjs probes, origin/main immutable review standards, and Protected Verification Paths), and Section D (issue tracker & domain docs). Waits for user confirmation before writing docs/agents/*.md and updating AGENTS.md.
assertions: Selects stack-docker-fullstack.md lazily without loading unrelated stack adapters
Proposes the two-branch (main + develop) topology in docs/agents/git-workflow.md
Proposes the 5-stage Dockerized commit pipeline in docs/agents/commit-pipeline.md
Proposes docs/agents/verification.md and docs/agents/stack.md with Dockerized commands and Protected Verification Paths
Proposes updating AGENTS.md in-place with a concise ## Agent skills block without creating a duplicate CLAUDE.md

evals.prompt: Set up rblf skills on this FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Alembic + Pytest repository. We only use a main branch (no develop branch), we run commands via uv on the host, and docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and docs/agents/domain.md were already created by setup-matt-pocock-skills.
evals.expected_output: Detects Python/FastAPI/Alembic/Pytest signals and lazily loads ONLY stack-python.md. Preserves existing docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and docs/agents/domain.md without overwriting or re-asking Section D. Proposes single-trunk (main-only) topology in docs/agents/git-workflow.md, a Python-appropriate staged commit pipeline (schema/Alembic migrations -> domain/API/tests -> generated OpenAPI/schemas -> docs) using python3/uv in docs/agents/commit-pipeline.md, and ruff/mypy/pytest verification gates in docs/agents/verification.md and docs/agents/stack.md.
assertions: Preserves existing docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and docs/agents/domain.md and skips Section D prompts
Configures single-trunk (main-only) promotion topology in docs/agents/git-workflow.md
Uses python3 / uv run for commands and enforces zero-flakiness pytest rules
